snippet.title: The Abyssal Diplomat
snippet.description:
The humans and the monsters can't agree on what year it is, a conflict that threatens to tear apart their sense of shared reality. A mysterious creature is called upon to bring the two communities together. 

The Abyssal Diplomat will do its best... But will its best be enough? 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3946640/The_Abyssal_Diplomat/
